summary.text: Angelo Puppolo is a Democratic state representative from the 12th Hampden District who has held the seat since 2007 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is an attorney and a former Springfield city councilor.

paragraphs.text: Angelo Puppolo Jr. earned an associate degree from Springfield Technical Community College, a bachelor's degree from American International College, and a law degree from the Western New England College of Law.
His professional experience includes working as an attorney and legislator.
He served on the Springfield City Council from 1998 to 2007, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs.
